svg.aria-label: An example chat. The person asks whether the week of 18 November, their best week of sleep, was a good week. Claude answers that it was also the largest strain episode in their record, with five vital signs off together for seven days, which usually means the body was fighting something off.
svg.text: Claude Desktop with health-context · synthetic demo data
I slept amazingly the week of 18 November.
Was that a good week for me?
It was your best week of sleep in two and a half years: 8.6 hours
a night. But it was also the biggest strain episode in your whole record.
For 7 days in a row, five signals moved the wrong way together against
your own baseline: wrist temperature, resting heart rate and breathing rate
up, HRV and blood oxygen down.
That pattern usually means your body was fighting something off, so the
extra sleep looks like recovery rather than a habit worth copying.
Do you remember being ill around then?
